# Don'ts
- donot commit and push without my approval. I will review and approve the changes before you commit and push them to the repository.

# Do's
- always create a new brach when creating a feature and doing somthing new. give it a name that is related to the feature you are creating. for example if you are creating a new feature called "user authentication" then create a branch called "feature/user-authentication". this will help us to keep track of the changes and also help us to review the code easily.
